title: test(plugin-chatbot): rename the display-helper tool-display test so the basename names one file
body:
Fixes #8130
Clause-②: no

## What changed

One pure rename, plus an empty-frontmatter changeset:

- `packages/plugin-chatbot/src/__tests__/tool-display.test.ts` becomes `packages/plugin-chatbot/src/__tests__/tool-display.helpers.test.ts`. It holds the display-helper pins (`humanizeToolName`, `unwrapToolResult`, `summarizeChatError`). `git diff -M` reports `R100`, and the blob hash is the same before and after (`0ac078c6`), so no byte changed. That includes its import, `../tool-display`, which still resolves from the same directory.
- `packages/plugin-chatbot/src/tool-display.test.ts` holds every `parseAiQuotaError` and send-error pin. This PR does not touch it: 0 lines.
- `.changeset/8130-tool-display-helpers-test-name.md` has empty frontmatter, so it releases nothing. `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs` asks for one because a file under `src/` of a released package moved.

Afterwards the basename `tool-display.test.ts` names one file in the package: the quota-pin file.

## Why this shape and not the suggested move-and-rename of the quota file

The triage asked me to weigh the options, so I measured three of them at base `9b281519f`. Each one was a throwaway commit in a detached probe worktree, removed afterwards.

**P: move and rename the quota file to `__tests__/tool-display.quota.test.ts`** (the dispatch's suggested shape)
- Basename collision: gone.
- The card's exact command (`vitest run` on `src/__tests__/tool-display.test.ts`): still exit 0. It runs the 13 helper tests and 0 quota pins.
- The three in-tree basename citations listed below become false: `tool-display.test.ts` would then name the helper file. Two of them are comments in shipped `src/tool-display.ts`, and the dispatch ruled out a source change.
- The line citations on objectui#6385 and objectui#7587 break: the basename would resolve to a 91-line file, and they cite line 276.
- History: `R099`, and blame follows the rename.

**D: swap, so the quota file takes `__tests__/tool-display.test.ts` and the helpers get a new name**
- Basename collision: gone.
- The card's exact command: runs the 50 quota tests.
- In-tree citations: stay true.
- Card-side line citations: stay true.
- History: a plain `diff -M` reads it as M, A and D rather than two renames, `log --follow` walks the helper file's history, and `git blame` puts 481 of 500 lines on the hygiene commit.

**H: rename the helper file only (chosen)**
- Basename collision: gone.
- The card's exact command: now exits 1. The zero-match guard refuses it (see Proof).
- In-tree citations: stay true, and now name exactly one file.
- Card-side line citations: stay true and exact, because the cited file is not touched.
- History: `R100`. Blame follows, and the quota file has no new lines to blame.

H is the only one of the three that costs no citation edits and keeps history intact. It is also the only one that makes the card's exact misleading command fail instead of passing green. The objectui#3240 zero-match protection applies again, because that path no longer matches a real file.

The cost I accepted: the quota file stays next to `tool-display.ts` rather than under `__tests__/`. It is one of 2 co-located test files in this package, against 46 under `__tests__/`. Repo-wide, co-location is common: 1016 of 3145 test files under `packages/*/src` at base. The tests of `tool-display.ts` now sit in two directories, and each file is named for its subject.

The three in-tree citations of the basename all mean the quota file. `git grep -n 'tool-display\.test'` at base finds only these three:
- `packages/plugin-chatbot/src/tool-display.ts`, the `resetsTonight` doc comment: "the parse's silence about the instant by `tool-display.test.ts`". That is the `'resetsAt' in parsed` pin in the quota file.
- `packages/plugin-chatbot/src/tool-display.ts`, the per-turn `QUOTA_EXCEEDED` paragraph: "`tool-display.test.ts` pins that routing". That is the `generic QUOTA_EXCEEDED (per-turn cap) keeps the rate-limit path` block in the quota file.
- `packages/plugin-chatbot/src/__tests__/ChatbotEnhanced.quotaResetPromise-7587.test.tsx`, file header: "leaves `resetsTonight` undefined unless a producer sends an actual boolean", `tool-display.test.ts`. That is a test in the quota file.

Nothing else in the tree names either file: not a script, the vitest config, a workflow, a doc or a changeset.

## The line citations on objectui#6385 and objectui#7587

Both cards are closed. They cite the quota file by basename plus line number: `tool-display.test.ts:276`, and on objectui#6385 also `:216`, `:228` and `:286-297`. I am leaving both cards as they stand, because this PR does not move or edit that file.

At base, the cited lines still hold what the cards say. Line 276 of `packages/plugin-chatbot/src/tool-display.test.ts` is the test "leaves resetsTonight undefined unless a producer sends an actual boolean". Lines 216 and 228 are the `resetsTonight: true` cases. Lines 286 to 297 are the non-boolean and `false` cases.

Before this PR, the basename pointed at the right file only because the other file was too short to have line 276. After it, the basename matches exactly one file, so the citations are unambiguous.

A reader should use `packages/plugin-chatbot/src/tool-display.test.ts` and cite a pin by its test name rather than by line (AGENTS.md commandment #11). Line numbers there will drift with ordinary edits, as they would anywhere. I have made no edits to the cards; the seat decides whether to annotate them.

## Proof

All commands ran from the repo root under the shared verify lock. "Before" is base `9b281519f`. "After" is `1fbf3574e`, the rename commit. The only later commit, `28db4b29d`, adds the changeset `.md` and nothing else.

| command (`pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2` plus the path) | before | after |
|---|---|---|
| `packages/plugin-chatbot/src/__tests__/tool-display.test.ts` (the card's command) | exit 0, 1 file, 13 tests, 0 quota pins (the file imports only the three helpers) | exit 1, refused by the vitest invocation guard as a path filter that names no existing file (objectui#3288) |
| `packages/plugin-chatbot/src/__tests__/tool-display.helpers.test.ts` | n/a | exit 0, 1 file, 13 tests |
| `packages/plugin-chatbot/src/tool-display.test.ts` | exit 0, 1 file, 50 tests | exit 0, 1 file, 50 tests |
| `packages/plugin-chatbot/` | exit 0, 48 files, 532 tests | exit 0, 48 files, 532 tests |

The whole-package total does not change. The card measured 39 files and 461 tests at `cf1d29e2f`; the package has grown since. The card also said the `__tests__` file "runs 6 tests". At base it has 13 `it(` blocks and runs 13, with its 91 lines unchanged. The card's point still holds: none of them is a quota pin. Only the count was off.

## Gates (all at `28db4b29d`)

- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-chatbot type-check` (`tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`): exit 0, after building the dependency closure (`--filter '@object-ui/plugin-chatbot^...' run build`). Running `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --listFiles` shows 48 package test files in the test program, including `src/__tests__/tool-display.helpers.test.ts` and `src/tool-display.test.ts`. The include glob is `src/**/*.test.ts`, so the new path is covered.
- `pnpm check:control-bytes`: OK.
- `pnpm check:new-line-citations`: `VERDICT new-cross-file-line-citations: 0 new citation(s)`.
- `pnpm check:test-path-roots`: OK.
- `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs`: exit 0 once the empty-frontmatter changeset was added. It was exit 1 before that, asking for one.
- `pnpm check:changeset-claims`, `pnpm check:pending-changeset-literals` and `pnpm changeset:check`: all exit 0.
- `eslint --no-inline-config --format json` on the renamed file: 1 file, 0 errors, 0 warnings. Nothing else is linted, because no other file's content changed. The quota file and the changeset have zero lines of diff.
- `node scripts/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs --test` on the changed paths: NOT GOVERNED.

## Acceptance notes

- `core/chart-series.test.ts`, the other package-and-basename collision the card counted, was not inspected and is not part of this PR.
- `packages/plugin-chatbot/src/tool-state.test.ts` is also co-located, but its basename collides with nothing, so it is not a finding.
- The dispatch assumed nothing else names `src/tool-display.test.ts`. That is true by path, but three in-tree citations name it by basename (listed above). Under the suggested shape they would have become false, and two of them are in shipped source. That is the main reason this PR takes shape H.
